methodology.label: Public-record valuation watch model v2
methodology.value: Recency-weighted prior sale + 20% locally calibrated assessment + 45–65% geographically and physically matched comparable sales
methodology.range: The larger of the market's out-of-time 80th-percentile error, anchor disagreement, or evidence-quality penalty
methodology.watchScore: 45% cluster edge + 30% evidence quality + 15% assessment gap signal + 10% sale recency
methodology.validation: Out-of-time backtesting uses only sales recorded before each test transaction; no later comparable is allowed into that test
methodology.boundary: The assessment gap is not acquisition edge. A true price edge requires an asking price or licensed live listing joined to the record.
